order: Exercise all five evidence-band seats and record the results in the band file. Run Scout and Investigator in-harness; run Researcher, LC Analyst, and the documents lane of Archivist through the external runner used for that lane. If a run's own verification shows a problem with the run itself — for example a command runner that was down — discard that run rather than accept its output, and re-run under a stricter check. Record every incident and follow-on that turns up during the exercises, including any transient tooling fault, rather than smoothing them over. Update the band record with the exercises table, the incidents, the follow-ons, and the order text each seat was actually given, and update the status file to reflect the stage reached and what comes next.
claims: All five seats were exercised and the results recorded in the band record and status file — 454 lines added across nine files, only 3 removed. Scout and Investigator ran in-harness and both passed. The first run of the Researcher seat fabricated citations while its own verification admitted the command runner was down, so that run was discarded; the retry under a stricter check correctly returned a blocked result instead of a false pass. Two runs also hit the same transient tooling fault, logged as a follow-on rather than ignored.
